sloka: वृद्धौ च माता पितराव् अहम् च एक इषुणा हतः ।केन स्म निहताः सर्वे सुबालेन अकृत आत्मना ॥२-६३-३५॥
transliteration: vṛddhau ca mātā pitarāv aham ca eka iṣuṇā hataḥ ।kena sma nihatāḥ sarve subālena akṛta ātmanā ॥2-63-35॥

translations.english: 'My aged parents along with me are killed by a single arrow. Who is that malicious knave who has slain us?
